name: starflask_generate_speech
description: Create a Starflask text-to-speech (audio) generation job. Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read the audio URL from the result. Pass the request as the `payload` object using the structured form: {"structured_data": {"model_key": "chatterbox-tts", "params": {"text": "Hello there", "voice": "<voice-id>"}}}. The job type is "audio" — this tool sends it for you. Use starflask_list_models to see available audio model keys and their input_schema (including supported voices).
